name: payments-api

metadata.name: payments-api
metadata.description: Payments API for the Acme storefront

manifest:
---
# Source: payments-api/templates/serviceaccount.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: payments-api
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: payments-api
---
# Source: payments-api/templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: payments-api
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
---
# Source: payments-api/templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: payments-api
spec:
  replicas: 4
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: payments-api
          image: ghcr.io/acme/payments-api:v2.14.3

hooks.name: payments-api-test-connection
hooks.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: payments-api-test-connection

hooks.name: payments-api-migrate
hooks.manifest:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: payments-api-migrate
